description:
Read the worker's report for a finished job, in pages of up to 25000 characters.
part="summary" (short answer), "findings" (evidence list), "steps" (Step log: done/partial/not done per step), "uncertain", "full" (whole report), "stderr" (backend error output, for debugging a failed job).

offset.description: Character offset, for paging through long parts.

part.description: Which part of the report to read.

name: offload_get_result
title: Read an offloaded job's report
